collections.name: Host Control ROMs
collections.description: Host-side ROM images which use One ROM's host-control plugin

roms.name: C64 Bootloader
roms.description: A C64 kernal bootloader compatible with cartridges. The c64c image is a combined 16KB kernal and basic ROM.

roms.name: C64 RBCP Reference Bootloader
roms.description: A C64 kernal bootloader reference implementation. Kernal and combined 16KB images.

roms.name: VIC-20 RBCP Reference Bootloader
roms.description: A VIC-20 kernal bootloader reference implementation

roms.name: Apple II RBCP Reference Bootloader
roms.description: An Apple II ROM bootloader reference implementation, a 2KB F8 image for a II or II+ and an 8KB EF image for a IIe

roms.name: Amiga RBCP Reference Bootloader
roms.description: An Amiga Kickstart bootloader reference implementation. 256KB and 512KB images.

roms.name: C64 RBCP Terminal
roms.description: Talks to a device over an RBCP pipe (USB) from a Commodore 64. Kernal, BASIC and combined 16KB images.

roms.name: VIC-20 RBCP Terminal
roms.description: Talks to a device over an RBCP pipe (USB) from a Commodore VIC-20. PAL and NTSC.

roms.name: Apple II RBCP Terminal
roms.description: Talks to a device over an RBCP pipe (USB) from an Apple IIe.

roms.name: C64 RBCP Aux I/O
roms.description: Drives and reads a device's auxiliary (GPIO) pins from a Commodore 64. Kernal, BASIC and combined 16KB images.

roms.name: VIC-20 RBCP Aux I/O
roms.description: Drives and reads a device's auxiliary (GPIO) pins from a Commodore VIC-20. Needs a 3KB RAM expansion. PAL and NTSC.

roms.name: Apple II RBCP Aux I/O
roms.description: Drives and reads a device's auxiliary (GPIO) pins from an Apple IIe.

roms.name: C64 RBCP Reliability Meter
roms.description: Measures how reliably a Commodore 64 and a device communicate over RBCP. Kernal, BASIC and combined 16KB images.

roms.name: VIC-20 RBCP Reliability Meter
roms.description: Measures how reliably a Commodore VIC-20 and a device communicate over RBCP. Needs a 3KB RAM expansion. PAL and NTSC.

roms.name: Apple II RBCP Reliability Meter
roms.description: Measures how reliably an Apple IIe and a device communicate over RBCP.

roms.name: C64 RBCP Pipe Throughput Test
roms.description: Measures how many bytes a Commodore 64 can push through an RBCP pipe (USB). Kernal, BASIC and combined 16KB images.

roms.name: VIC-20 RBCP Pipe Throughput Test
roms.description: Measures how many bytes a Commodore VIC-20 can push through an RBCP pipe (USB). Needs a 3KB RAM expansion. PAL and NTSC.

roms.name: Apple II RBCP Pipe Throughput Test
roms.description: Measures how many bytes an Apple IIe can push through an RBCP pipe (USB). 50Hz and 60Hz images.

roms.name: C64 RBCP LED Tester
roms.description: Drives a device's LEDs from a Commodore 64. Kernal, BASIC and combined 16KB images.

roms.name: Amiga RBCP Terminal
roms.description: Talks to a device over an RBCP pipe (USB) from an Amiga. 256KB and 512KB images.

roms.name: Amiga RBCP LED Tester
roms.description: Drives a device's LEDs from an Amiga. 256KB and 512KB images.

roms.name: Amiga RBCP Aux I/O
roms.description: Drives and reads a device's auxiliary (GPIO) pins from an Amiga. 256KB and 512KB images.

roms.name: Amiga RBCP Pipe Throughput Test
roms.description: Measures how many bytes an Amiga can push through an RBCP pipe (USB). 256KB and 512KB images.

roms.name: Amiga RBCP Reliability Meter
roms.description: Measures how reliably an Amiga and a device communicate over RBCP. 256KB and 512KB images.
